source_excerpt:
An easier way to use AI on your own computer. A free, open-source alternative to Claude and ChatGPT.
Visit hob.chat → · Download for Mac · Windows · Linux
Fill out PDFs, work through documents, and much more. Free, private, and works offline. Hob picks the best frontier open-weight model that fits your computer and sets everything up for you.
Help · Contributing · MIT license Made by Frigade .
An easier way to use AI on your own computer. A free, open-source alternative to Claude and ChatGPT that runs open-weight models like Gemma and gpt-oss locally on Mac, Windows and Linux. Private, and works offline.
